articles.title: Redesigned Health app expands language support
articles.summary: Apple announced expanded language support for the redesigned Health app, bringing personalized health insights to millions of people worldwide.
bodyEvidence: Text of this article
Redesigned Health app expands language support

Today, Apple’s redesigned Health app will expand language support to global English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish, and Vietnamese, bringing powerful, personalized health insights to millions of people worldwide. 1 Built with Apple Intelligence at its core, the Health app dynamically adapts to an individual’s health metrics across iPhone and iPad, offering insight into how to optimize their day and a comprehensive view of long-term wellbeing. 2, 3 The Health app has been built to securely and privately protect a user’s data at every step.

The updated experience includes a new Insights tab that surfaces timely, holistic summaries spanning heart, sleep, readiness, fitness, vitals, and cycle tracking data throughout the day. A dedicated For You section delivers intelligent recommendations tailored to a user’s daily habits — such as practical guidance to adjust a wind-down routine following consecutive nights of interrupted sleep. The app pairs data with dynamic health content, offering educational videos and articles featuring Health app clinical experts.

To help users better understand their health trajectory, a new Longevity tab analyzes longitudinal metrics across heart health, sleep, mental wellbeing, movement, metabolic health, hearing, and nutrition. Central to this tab is Health Age, a feature that translates data from Apple Watch — including VO 2 max, resting heart rate, sleep, and heart rate variability — into a metric that reflects how a user’s body is tracking relative to their chronological age. Users can also incorporate clinical laboratory data, such as A1c and LDL cholesterol, to enrich their long-term health picture.

Additionally, the update introduces at-home movement evaluations, which make physical assessments accessible without requiring specialized equipment. Using an iPhone camera and Apple Watch, users can measure their flexibility, strength, balance, movement mechanics, and VO 2 max with real-time audio and visual feedback. Powered by on-device vision-based AI models and developed with clinical experts, the experience runs entirely on device; no video is ever recorded, stored, or shared.

The redesigned Health app is available in the iOS 27.3 developer beta today and will roll out to users as a free software update later this year. Apple will continue to expand support for the redesigned Health app in new languages.

articles.title: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display
articles.summary: Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology.
bodyEvidence: Text of this article
Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch for the first time on Mac

The world’s best pro laptop now features an industry-leading tandem OLED display, an intuitive Touch experience, blazing-fast M5 Pro and M5 Max performance and AI capabilities, and up to 24 hours of battery life, all in a thinner, lighter design

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display , featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI. 2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes. 3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. 2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.”
PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop

The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go.
A Tandem OLED Display Unlike Any Other

PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display.
Breathtaking Brightness and Contrast

PROLED XDR offers up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, allowing specular highlights to shine with stunning intensity. And through optimizations in the tandem OLED panel and custom compensation techniques, combined with precise control of light across the display, the PROLED XDR display achieves an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, so even the deepest shadows reveal incredible detail, bringing HDR content remarkably close to reality.
An Advanced Display Engine

The display engine precisely controls the color and luminance of every pixel at the sub-millisecond level, compensating for content, pixel use, temperature, and environment all at once to offer exceptional brightness uniformity and grayscale accuracy, even in fast-motion content. It also monitors and adapts each pixel’s usage over time to preserve stunning image quality. And ProMotion technology delivers adaptive refresh rates from as low as 10Hz for better power efficiency and up to 120Hz for fluid responsiveness for content in motion.
The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows

PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go.
Stunning Clarity in Bright Light

With up to 2000 nits peak SDR brightness, combined with a state-of-the-art antireflective coating, the display is easy to read even in bright lighting conditions. For even greater visibility, the nano-texture option — now precisely etched into the cover glass — further reduces reflections and glare to eliminate distractions while maintaining an excellent viewing experience.

With breakthrough tandem OLED technology, extreme brightness, and extraordinary contrast, along with a super-wide color gamut, PROLED XDR is truly the world’s best laptop display, giving pros an unparalleled visual experience and setting a whole new bar for the industry.
Touch Arrives on Mac

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.

Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro. 4
Say Hello to the Dynamic Island on Mac

The Dynamic Island comes to the Mac, serving as the new home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI, where users can quickly search for anything on their MacBook Pro, access real-time updates, or take advantage of Siri AI. 1 Just like on iPhone, the Dynamic Island provides a quick, intuitive way to see and interact with important information. Users can ask a question, pick up a phone call, or control music — all within easy reach. With Live Activities, users can now get timely updates at a glance, and can accept an AirDrop request or pause a song with a tap of their finger.
A Thinner and Much Lighter New Design

The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. 5 Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner.

With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. 6 And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display.
M5 Pro and M5 Max: Game‑Changing Pro Performance and On-Device AI

The new MacBook Pro features M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop. Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows. M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video. M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers. With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production.

A powerful Neural Accelerator built into each GPU core lets users speed through AI workloads like running a coding agent with an on-device LLM. And users are able to power through advanced graphics-intensive tasks like rendering a complex scene in Cinema 4D with Redshift. M5 Pro and M5 Max each feature a GPU with enhanced shader cores and a third-generation ray-tracing engine, delivering more photorealistic lighting and faster renders for 3D modeling. Dynamic Caching optimizes on-chip memory to significantly increase GPU utilization, driving huge performance boosts for apps like Blender and Unreal Engine, along with AAA games.
The Best Audio System in a Laptop

The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.
Additional New Features for Pro Workflows

The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. 7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.
Advanced Pro Connectivity

The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. 3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.
macOS 27 Golden Gate

The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.

Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment

The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new MacBook Pro is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.

Supercharged by M6, the 14-inch MacBook Pro features incredible performance and next-level AI capabilities, enhanced connectivity, and up to 24 hours of battery life, delivering even more value

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 , delivering even more performance, powerful on-device AI capabilities, and faster connectivity for college students, business users, creators, and more. M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world’s fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive. 1 The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5, making the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 a compelling value for users who need serious power. 2 For those upgrading from M1, the performance gains are even more significant, with up to 11x faster graphics and up to 13x faster AI performance. 3 With additional Neural Accelerators in the GPU and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, M6 turns MacBook Pro into an even more powerful platform for AI — from taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS to running LLMs locally, all while preserving user privacy. 4 In addition, the 14-inch MacBook Pro features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, while superfast storage makes working with large files, exporting projects, and running demanding AI workflows fly. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 does all this with industry-leading performance per watt and up to 24 hours of battery life, the longest ever in a Mac. With 16GB of unified memory standard, configurable up to 32GB, and higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, MacBook Pro makes multitasking and working with demanding apps and large projects even faster.

From families and aspiring creators to small businesses, users will experience the speed and power of M6 in everything they do. Featuring a faster CPU and GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, it blazes through everyday apps and multitasking while delivering powerful performance for creative workflows like photo and video editing. For Intel-based upgraders, the leap is even greater, with up to 18x faster performance than the most popular Intel-based iMac. 1 And together with the Dual 16-core Neural Engine, the new iMac delivers up to 5x faster on-device AI performance than M4. 1 Whether users are taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS, running local AI models, or vibe coding, iMac is a powerful platform for AI while preserving user privacy. 2 Connectivity gets even better with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, along with available 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet and storage that is up to 2x faster, so apps and large projects launch in an instant. 3 Completing the iMac experience is an expansive 24-inch 4.5K Retina display; an industry-leading camera, speakers, and mics; up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports; color-matched accessories; and the power of macOS 27. Available in a spectrum of seven colors — blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver — the new iMac is a tremendous upgrade for existing users and an incredible gateway into everything the Mac can do for new users. Customers can pre-order starting tomorrow, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“iMac is the world’s best all-in-one, and today it raises the bar yet again,” said Shelly Goldberg, Apple’s vice president of Hardware Engineering. “With the blazing performance and AI capabilities of M6 supercharging every workflow and the next generation of Apple Intelligence with Siri AI — combined with its stunning 24-inch Retina display, its gorgeous design in seven vibrant colors, and macOS 27 — the new iMac has everything users need to run their businesses, manage their lives, and bring their ideas to life.”
iMac with M6: A Huge Leap in Performance and AI Capabilities

With M6, iMac brings even more performance, for everything from everyday productivity to creative workloads and AI tasks. iMac with M6 features up to a 12-core CPU — two more cores than before — delivering the world’s fastest single-threaded CPU performance. 4 Everything feels extra snappy and responsive for families managing busy calendars, students putting the finishing touches on a project, and small business owners running their companies. An up-to-12-core GPU, also with two more cores than before, now features Neural Accelerators in each core, delivering up to 2x faster graphics for more intensive tasks like photo editing, along with fantastic gaming performance compared to M4. 3 Students and creators can now fly through tasks like editing and sharing their latest videos or designing a project for class, all while multitasking with their favorite messaging or entertainment apps. The new Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 2x faster AI compute than the previous generation, and combined with the advanced GPU and faster memory bandwidth and with higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, iMac rips through AI tasks like running LLMs on device. 3 With all this performance packed into its stunning design, iMac is the perfect all-in-one for a wide range of users and workflows.
The new iMac with M6 enables:
iMac with M6: A Powerful Platform for AI

Beyond delivering exceptional performance for everyday productivity and creative workflows, iMac is also a powerful platform for AI, enabling users to take advantage of advanced AI capabilities while protecting their privacy. With macOS 27, the next generation of Apple Intelligence is deeply personal, seamlessly integrated across apps, and built with privacy from the ground up. Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI, a new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal, helping users get more done than ever before. On iMac, users can tap into Siri AI to ask questions; find what they need across their messages, emails, photos, and more; and take action across apps. Siri AI is built right into Spotlight, making it easy to search for answers on virtually any topic and ask follow-up questions. With the expansive 24-inch 4.5K Retina display, users can leverage Visual Intelligence with a dedicated keyboard shortcut to ask Siri about anything on their screen, from a chart in a spreadsheet to a photo in a browser tab. Users can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type, and in Mail and Messages, Siri can reflect their typical style and tone.

Apple Intelligence also makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notifies them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enables the creation of custom extensions based on a description. In addition, users can easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. iMac also supports a growing ecosystem of AI apps optimized for Apple silicon, including LM Studio Bionic and Topaz Studio, helping users learn faster, think in new ways, and get more done.
Best-in-Class Connectivity and Faster Storage

The new iMac features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, along with 2.5Gb Ethernet that delivers up to 2.5x faster wired connectivity than the previous generation. 5 This means faster transfers of large files, smoother streaming of high-resolution content, and even better performance for gaming and demanding business workflows. And with up to 2x faster SSD read and write performance, apps launch quickly, and large files like photo libraries and video projects load in an instant. 3

Up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports enable superfast data transfers and make it easy to connect a wide range of accessories, including external storage and docks. 6 Users can also connect up to two 6K external displays, creating a vast workspace with more than 50 million pixels to spread out their work.
A Transformational Upgrade

The new iMac is a tremendous upgrade — especially for users coming from an Intel-based iMac, who will experience performance that’s up to 18x faster. 1 And with macOS 27, Siri AI and new Apple Intelligence features integrated across apps make AI tasks on iMac more personal and powerful than ever.
iMac also includes all of the popular features and capabilities that make it the world’s best all-in-one:
macOS 27 Golden Gate: An Unrivaled Experience

The new iMac comes to life with macOS 27 . In addition to Siri AI and Apple Intelligence, iMac gets even more responsive, reliable, and delightful for everyday use with refinements to design, performance, search, and more. Updates to Liquid Glass deliver a more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
iMac and the Environment

The new iMac was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the stand, 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, and 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards. It is manufactured with 40 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new iMac meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.

articles.title: Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools
articles.summary: Apple introduces updates to Apple Creator Studio, the collection of creative apps designed to put studio-grade tools into the hands of creators.
bodyEvidence: Text of this article
Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools

Updates bring built-in MotionVFX content to Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, expanded music creation tools to Logic Pro, and new intelligence features to Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced transformative updates to Apple Creator Studio , the powerful collection of creative apps designed to put studio-grade tools into the hands of modern creators across Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Final Cut Pro for Mac now includes built-in MotionVFX — an expansive collection of visual effects, plug-ins, transitions, templates, and motion graphics tools — as well as seamless editing in Pixelmator Pro. Apple’s curated Content Hub now includes video assets and is available in Final Cut Pro. Music creators using Logic Pro for Mac gain a new intelligent assistant in beta, 1 an enhanced Stem Splitter that now separates drums, and a redesigned Browser that incorporates all sounds, with music understanding and even a Splice library. Pixelmator Pro introduces Generate Fill, which lets creators transform selected areas of an image using natural language. Keynote, Pages, and Numbers introduce new AI features in beta, including assistants 2 that understand document context and new Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for workflow automation. 3 They also add stock video in the Content Hub and new premium themes and templates.
Apple Creator Studio updates will be available on the App Store this November as a free update for existing subscribers. 4

“This is our most exciting update since the launch of Apple Creator Studio. MotionVFX content in Final Cut Pro gives subscribers rapid access to extensive professional video effects and content, bringing incredible value to the suite,” said Brent Chiu-Watson, Apple’s senior director of Worldwide Product Marketing for Apps and iCloud. “Logic Pro’s new Browser allows users to explore and experiment with more sounds than ever as they create music. Pixelmator Pro’s sophisticated fill capabilities now let users completely reimagine any part of an image. And the assistant capabilities in Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers are going to change the game for how people interact with and learn to use these apps.”
Expansive New Creative Toolkits and Video Workflows

Final Cut Pro for Mac and iPad delivers an exceptional set of new capabilities for video editors, content creators, and filmmakers, from emerging storytellers to seasoned professionals deep in complex edits. Final Cut Pro for Mac now integrates MotionVFX directly into the app, giving editors access to thousands of elements, including templates with unique themes, stylish graphics, titles, and transitions, as well as tools for rotoscoping, tracking, and color grading. Editors can also tap into the Content Hub directly within Final Cut Pro and access a library of Apple-curated stock videos, photos, and backgrounds to fill gaps, add polish, or spark new ideas without leaving their workflow.

Cross-app workflows and visual creation also take a major leap forward in Final Cut Pro. Editors can open any image from their timeline directly in Pixelmator Pro, take advantage of advanced editing tools, and save changes back to the project automatically — no reimporting required. With advanced image generation, users can create stunning images from text descriptions right inside their project, apply quick edits, and adjust visual styles. And Final Cut Pro introduces powerful workflow improvements, including more keyframe easing options for finer animation control, the ability to disconnect clips from the primary storyline to place them anywhere on the timeline, and 23 new transcription languages, making it easier than ever to caption and search footage.

Motion also adds a built-in set of powerful MotionVFX plug-ins for cinematic color grading, 3D camera tracking, and one-click selection for stunning visual effects. Users can now generate and edit images from text descriptions, send images round-trip to Pixelmator Pro, fine-tune keyframe easing, and apply an all-new Displacement filter. Additionally, Compressor introduces the ability to encode Cinematic mode video recorded on iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.
Reimagined Image Editing

Pixelmator Pro introduces Generate Fill, a powerful new tool to edit images based on a user’s description. Creators can simply circle an area in an image and describe the change they want. For more precision, creators can use existing Pixelmator Pro selection tools, like Free Selection, Quick Selection, or Magnetic Selection. Generate Fill automatically matches the lighting, perspective, and texture of the surrounding environment so edits blend in seamlessly, while built-in Super Resolution upscales the generated content so it stays sharp at any size. Generated elements can be merged into existing layers or inserted as new layers with intelligent masking that allows for continued refinement.
Taking Music Creation Even Further

Logic Pro for Mac and iPad brings sophisticated, intuitive new tools for beat making, songwriting, remixing, and production. It also gets an all-new design featuring Liquid Glass, with translucent surfaces and deeper contrast that highlight waveforms and tracks.

A new intelligent assistant powered by a combination of Apple-built and third-party models joins Logic Pro for Mac, helping creators and producers navigate production workflows, start a new song, set up a vocal track from a single prompt, or refine an active project.¹ Finding the perfect sound is faster and more intuitive than ever with a redesigned Browser on Mac that centralizes loops, instruments, effect patches, and more. Powered by music understanding — an on-device audio analysis tool — Logic Pro automatically analyzes, classifies, and tags added sounds so creators can easily search their entire collection or drag in a loop to surface matching audio.

Logic Pro’s industry-leading Stem Splitter gets even more advanced, with the ability to isolate, replace, or rebalance drum parts without needing the original multitracks. Users can also unlock a new Producer Pack from the 20-time Grammy winner and visionary widely known as the King of Modern Salsa, Sergio George. In this Producer Pack, George opens up his toolbox with his signature piano sound and authentic Latin jazz and salsa loops, including a full salsa percussion section, brass ensemble, and basses.
With Voice Memo Studio Sound, users can also reduce room ambience and background noise in recordings captured on supported iPhone models, with the option to continue fine-tuning in Logic Pro.
Powering Productivity with In-App Intelligence

Visual productivity apps receive a new generation of intelligence features for subscribers, including an intelligent assistant, built on Apple models and OpenAI, directly within Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. The assistant understands document context to help users accomplish more without leaving their work.² In Keynote, the intelligent assistant helps with designing, animating, and refining slides. In Pages, it drafts, restructures, and fine-tunes written content. In Numbers, it calculates, visualizes, and organizes data; recommends suitable chart types with a one-tap preview; and builds custom tables using world knowledge. New MCP support, built on this platform, enables external AI agents and tools to read content, perform edits, and execute automated actions directly in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.
More Creative Options and Formats

Across Keynote, Pages, and Numbers, the Content Hub expands to include Apple-curated stock video footage, giving creators dynamic visuals to enhance presentations, reports, and spreadsheets. Subscribers also gain access to a fresh collection of professionally designed templates and themes. Keynote introduces support for Keynote Interchange Format (.keyx), an open JSON-based bundle file format designed to be readable and accessible to external tools, developer workflows, and AI agents.

Freeform adds text styles for one-step formatting and reuse across boards, custom and preset board background colors, and, arriving in December, the ability to edit images directly in Pixelmator Pro and generate editable shapes from text descriptions.

articles.title: Apple gives iPad mini its biggest update ever
articles.summary: Apple unveils the all-new iPad mini, featuring an OLED display in a thinner design, a leap in performance with A20 Pro, and water and dust resistance.
bodyEvidence: Text of this article
Apple gives iPad mini its biggest update ever
Featuring a stunning OLED display in an even thinner and lighter design, a huge leap in performance, faster wireless connectivity, and water and dust resistance

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today unveiled the all-new iPad mini , featuring a stunning OLED display in an even thinner and lighter design, a huge leap in performance with A20 Pro, and water and dust resistance. 1 The larger 8.5-inch OLED display, also available with a nano-texture option, delivers higher contrast and more than 2x higher peak brightness than the previous-generation iPad mini for a brilliant and immersive viewing experience. 2 A20 Pro supercharges AI with Neural Accelerators in each GPU core and Dual 16-core Neural Engine. iPad mini now has a 12MP Center Stage front camera on the landscape edge that’s perfect for video calls, an innovative Acoustic Display for an even better audio experience, faster wireless and cellular connectivity, and fast-charge support. 3 With its incredible set of advanced features, it’s the most capable and versatile iPad mini ever.

The new iPad mini is powered by iPadOS 27 with the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, which can draw on a user’s personal context to help them find what they need, answer questions on virtually any topic with broad world knowledge, and understand what’s on their screen. 4 The combination of powerful features and game-changing iPadOS 27 capabilities makes the new iPad mini a compelling value. Customers can pre-order it along with the new Smart Folio starting Wednesday, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“iPad mini is beloved for its fantastic portability, performance, and display by a wide range of users, from creators and small business owners to doctors, field service workers, and gamers,” said Dave Pakula, Apple’s vice president of Hardware Engineering. “With a remarkably thinner and lighter design, a stunning new OLED display, the incredibly powerful A20 Pro, and water and dust resistance, the new iPad mini is a huge leap forward for users who love having the full iPad experience in the palm of their hand.”
Thinner and Lighter Than Ever

At 5.4 mm thin, the new iPad mini is more portable than ever, and is available in two gorgeous finishes: a new midnight and a beautiful starlight. Remarkably thinner and lighter than the previous generation, iPad mini is now even easier to carry, whether a user is reading, working on the go, or using it with one hand. It also features an IP67 rating to protect against water and dust — ideal for a range of use cases, such as working outside on a rainy day or reading by the pool. 1
A Stunning OLED Display

The new iPad mini comes with a stunning OLED display that delivers amazing front-of-screen performance and an even larger 8.5-inch size while maintaining the same footprint as the previous mini, thanks to 24 percent thinner bezels. 2 The Super Retina XDR display features OLED technology to deliver pixel-level lighting control for much deeper blacks and support for the P3 wide color gamut for more vivid and accurate imagery.

For an even better visual experience across a range of lighting conditions, iPad mini also features peak brightness of up to 1200 nits — more than 2x higher than the previous generation — and supports 600 nits of full-screen brightness for SDR and HDR content, along with a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio. And with a 1-nit minimum brightness, iPad mini is even more suitable for dim environments, from users reading in bed at night to pilots checking their electronic flight bag in the cockpit. iPad mini also offers a new nano-texture display option, which users love on iPad Pro, that reduces glare in bright environments — ideal for creatives editing outdoors or technicians working in the field. Together, these display advancements extend the versatility of iPad mini across an even wider range of use cases.
A Huge Leap in Performance

A20 Pro delivers a giant leap in performance for iPad mini, significantly boosting graphics and AI-intensive tasks. It is built using Apple’s latest 2-nanometer process technology and a new package inspired by M-series chips. Powered by a 7-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each GPU core, iPad mini delivers up to 4.5x faster AI performance than the previous generation — perfect for AI tasks ranging from running on-device models in creative apps to running local LLMs. 3 And with the latest graphics architecture, including dynamic caching and hardware-accelerated mesh shading and ray tracing, graphics performance jumps by up to 2.7x — great for gaming and 3D rendering. 3 A20 Pro also features up to a 6-core CPU for up to 60 percent faster multithreaded performance for everyday tasks like editing photos and working across apps. 3

The 512GB configuration features a powerful Dual 16-core Neural Engine, which offers double the processing power of the previous generation, accelerating tasks in apps like Draw Things and Detail. By engaging all 32 cores, A20 Pro becomes a powerhouse for more advanced on-device AI workloads. A20 Pro also brings over a 2x increase in unified memory bandwidth, unlocking additional performance for new levels of capability and responsiveness across graphics and AI-intensive workloads.
A Rich New Audio Experience and Advanced Cameras

The new iPad mini features an innovative Acoustic Display for an even better audio experience when gaming, watching videos, or editing content. Specially designed woofers are paired through the display to produce punchier bass and more volume. In addition, custom tweeters are now hidden between the glass and aluminum enclosure for clearer highs. The Acoustic Display also features a sealed enclosure that helps iPad mini achieve its IP67 rating.

The 12MP Center Stage front camera is now on the landscape edge, perfect for FaceTime calls, video conferencing, and collaboration. And the 12MP Wide back camera captures gorgeous photos with Smart HDR 4 and 4K video at up to 60 fps, while the addition of an Adaptive True Tone flash improves photos and makes document scanning better than ever.
N1 and C2 Come to iPad mini

iPad mini now features N1, an Apple-designed wireless networking chip that enables Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. 5 N1 brings better performance when connected to 5GHz Wi-Fi networks and improves the overall performance and reliability of features like AirDrop and AirPlay. 6

Cellular models of the new iPad mini feature C2, Apple’s next-generation cellular modem system. C2 enables up to 50 percent faster cellular data speeds compared to the previous generation of iPad mini, with even greater power efficiency. 6 And with iPadOS 27, moving between cellular and Wi-Fi networks is more seamless than ever, so users can stay connected on a FaceTime call even while they’re in transit. Users can also enjoy the benefits of eSIM, which lets them quickly and securely add a new plan, connect and transfer existing plans digitally, and stay in touch with family and friends regardless of Wi-Fi availability. 7
iPadOS 27 with the Next Generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI

iPad mini users can get even more done with Siri AI, rolling out in beta with iPadOS 27. Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri, powered by Apple Intelligence, that is profoundly more personal, capable, and conversational. 4 iPad mini also supports Apple’s most advanced on-device model ever, for even more expressive voices with Siri AI as well as a major boost in accuracy with systemwide dictation.

Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across their personal messages, emails, photos, and more; use onscreen awareness to take action related to the content on a user’s screen; and answer questions about virtually any topic. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. Users can improve a photo’s composition after it’s been taken using tools such as upgraded Clean Up, Spatial Reframing, and Extend. And now the all-new Image Playground app offers photorealistic imagery. In Safari, Notify Me helps users monitor web pages for changes, like product restocks or price drops, and stay on top of updates. Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute to help protect users’ privacy. When Private Cloud Compute is handling users’ requests, their personal data is not stored nor made accessible to Apple or anyone else.

iPadOS 27 also delivers an expansive set of improvements that make iPad more responsive, reliable, and easy to use, along with updates to Liquid Glass, including a new slider in Settings that gives users the option to personalize it, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference. With iPadOS 27.2, iPad mini also supports extended display mode when connected to an external display, great for users multitasking with windowed apps.

Additionally, powerful and easy-to-use tools help parents manage what their kids can see, who they can talk to, and when they have access to apps. For parents and families looking for more information on how to help create safer, more enriching digital experiences for their kids, Apple also has a website with details on the latest tools and how to get started using them.
Accessories That Unlock More Ways to Be Productive and Creative

The new Smart Folio features a two-panel architecture, offering a slim, lightweight cover that magnetically attaches to iPad mini. 8 Crafted with TechWoven fabric in navy blue and taupe to complement the iPad mini finishes, the Smart Folio has an adjustable design that gives users a greater range of motion, including new viewing angles, for enhanced versatility.

iPad mini supports both Apple Pencil (USB-C) and Apple Pencil Pro, giving users two incredible options to bring their ideas to life. 8 Apple Pencil (USB-C) is a great value for everyday tasks like note-taking and sketching, while Apple Pencil Pro delivers industry-leading capabilities for the ultimate pencil experience. With Apple Pencil Pro, users can take advantage of innovative features like squeeze and barrel roll to work in entirely new ways, as well as utilize Find My support to help locate it when misplaced.
iPad mini and the Environment

iPad mini was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 35 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure and 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery. iPad mini is manufactured with 40 percent renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain. It is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.

First Formula 1 race to be broadcast in Dolby Atmos will deliver a more immersive viewing experience for fans
Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend for the FORMULA 1® MSC CRUISES UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX™ 2026 — streaming in the U.S. exclusively on Apple TV, with every session live and on demand. 1

The championship battle intensifies as F1 enters the final quarter of the season. Watch Mercedes’s Kimi Antonelli chase history at the United States Grand Prix, as the Italian has a chance to clinch his first Drivers’ Championship and become the youngest to win the title. The stakes are high as teams arrive at Circuit of The Americas in Austin, Texas, for a pivotal weekend in the championship race.
The Ultimate Destination for F1 Fans in the U.S.

Apple TV is the U.S. home of F1 — delivering comprehensive coverage and analysis, powerful and customizable viewing features, and seamless integration across the Apple ecosystem to Apple TV subscribers.

United States Grand Prix coverage will feature English and Spanish commentary and access to up to 30 additional live feeds across all sessions, including Driver Tracker for a bird’s-eye view of the race, session timing and data feeds, a mixed onboard feed that automatically switches between cameras as the action unfolds, and a Podium feed that dynamically follows the drivers running in P1, P2, and P3 throughout. 2

Viewers can also get closer to the action with Multiview, a feature that brings together up to four live feeds on a single screen for an even more immersive race-day experience. And now Multiview is available on supported smart TVs in addition to Apple devices and streaming players — so more fans than ever can follow every angle and won’t miss a moment.
F1 on Apple TV Now Available in Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision

Starting with the United States Grand Prix, Dolby Atmos® will come to F1 on Apple TV, joining Dolby Vision® to give U.S. subscribers an even more immersive race-weekend experience. Dolby Atmos surrounds fans with the sounds of race weekend, from team radio and commentary to roaring engines, on-track battles, and pit-lane intensity. Paired with Dolby Vision’s rich colors and lifelike clarity, the combination delivers exceptional sound and spectacular visuals that put fans at the heart of the action.
F1 in Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos is available through the Apple TV app on supported Apple devices and compatible Dolby-enabled TVs, soundbars, and home theater systems.
Original F1 Programming on Apple TV

Apple TV brings fans closer to the action with original programming, delivering fresh expert perspectives to race weekend and sharing deeper insights into the stories shaping F1 — from every curve, overtake, and podium.

Circuits in Focus — the dynamic track preview series featuring 2016 F1 World Champion Nico Rosberg and content creator, record-breaking car builder, and driver Emelia Hartford — returns to Apple TV for the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix. Ahead of race weekend, Rosberg and Hartford take viewers inside one of F1’s most exciting circuits, breaking down the technical challenges, race strategies, and split-second decisions that could shape the fight for the podium.

Using EA SPORTS™ F1® 25, the official video game of the FIA Formula One World Championship™, Rosberg and Hartford put fans in the driver’s seat as they navigate Circuit of The Americas’ signature corners, dramatic elevation changes, and high-speed straights, revealing the key overtaking opportunities and strategic moments that could make all the difference on race day.

Full Throttle returns with an adrenaline-fueled episode that combines thrilling action, adventure, and unexpected moments. Hosted by content creator and engineer Christina Roki, whose personality and passion for all things cars set the tone, this energetic segment pairs her with F1 driver Yuki Tsunoda as he puts his driving skills to the test on the new off-road track at Circuit of The Americas. Packed with excitement and plenty of surprises, Full Throttle delivers a fresh, fun, and engaging take on the world of racing.

Fans can follow the race after it wraps with The POV, a social series that features former Red Bull Racing senior technician Calum Nicholas and Roki reacting to key moments from the weekend. Whether highlighting decisive overtakes, strategy calls, or unexpected turning points, the series’ coverage blends technical expertise with a fan-first perspective.
Together, these shows make it easy for audiences to engage with F1 on and off the track.
Race Weekend Comes to Apple Domain NORTHSIDE
In celebration of the United States Grand Prix, Apple TV is bringing the thrill of race weekend to Apple Domain NORTHSIDE, in Austin, with exclusive programming and interactive sessions.

On Thursday, October 22, special Today at Apple sessions inspired by the Haas F1 Team invite customers to capture portraits of official driver suits and helmets on iPhone 18 Pro, or design custom car liveries on iPad Pro with Apple Pencil Pro. Outside on the lawn, attendees can view Haas’s special-edition livery up close and join a live Q&A with Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu, F1 drivers Esteban Ocon and Ollie Bearman, and American F1 Academy driver Kaylee Countryman. Fans can register to reserve a spot for the F1-themed Today at Apple sessions.
The action culminates on Sunday, October 25, when fans can catch the Apple TV broadcast of the United States Grand Prix streamed live at the store.
Follow Race Weekend with Apple Sports

Fans can keep up with their favorite teams and drivers all season long with the free Apple Sports app for iPhone. Designed for speed and simplicity, the app puts favorite leagues and teams front and center. F1 fans get real-time leaderboards, drivers’ and teams’ standings, and live updates for every qualifying, Sprint, and race session — all with quick access to the live race page on Apple TV.

With Live Activities, 3 Apple Sports delivers real-time updates to the iPhone Lock Screen and Apple Watch so fans never miss a moment. Game Card Sharing lets fans share their excitement for any Grand Prix. Fans can also follow F1 across Apple TV, Apple Sports, and Apple News with My Sports, which syncs users’ favorites across supported apps.
Explore the United States Grand Prix in Austin with Apple Maps

F1 fans can use Apple Maps to explore the Grand Prix in immersive detail, including a comprehensive circuit map with turn numbers, grandstands, and specially designed 3D landmarks like the F1 pit building, COTA Tower, and COTALAND Theme Park. For fans attending in person, Maps makes it easy to get around the Grand Prix, with useful information about grandstands, entry gates, rideshare locations, road closures, pedestrian walkways, and more.

Additionally, Apple Maps users can better navigate Austin with the new Detailed City Experience, which offers more in-depth road coverage, improved directions, and immersive 3D landmarks, including Q2 Stadium, Sixth Street, and Moody Center. Locals and visitors can also discover some of the city’s best places to eat, drink, and shop with country singer-songwriter Dylan Gossett’s Austin Spots guide.
Exclusive Playlists and DJ Mixes on Apple Music

Apple Music subscribers can get into race weekend mode for the United States Grand Prix with an exclusive new DJ mix from producer, songwriter, and GRAMMY Award winner Diplo. Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson will also debut his personal driver playlist, giving listeners a glimpse into the songs that fuel his focus on and off the track. Subscribers can explore Apple Music’s curated collection celebrating the pinnacle of motorsport with more driver playlists, exclusive DJ mixes, and a refreshed Formula 1: Sounds of the Circuit playlist capturing the energy of race weekend and beyond.
In-Depth Coverage and a Glimpse into Race Weekend with Apple News

Fans can stay up to date on race weekend in Apple News with notifications and personalized coverage from leading publishers, and can track their favorite drivers and teams for live results, standings, and highlights. Users can also view the race directly within the News app through a special United States Grand Prix feature and easily jump to the Apple TV app for the full F1 streaming experience.
Experience the United States Grand Prix Live in IMAX

Fans across the country can also experience the United States Grand Prix live in IMAX, with special screenings at more than 50 locations nationwide. See every turn and straightaway come to life on IMAX’s expansive screens, with precision surround sound that puts fans closer to every engine roar. In the heart of Austin, fans can catch the action at a special local screening at the IMAX Theatre at the Bullock Texas State History Museum.
More information and tickets are available at imax.com/f1-live-in-imax .
Tubi Creator-Hosted Live Altcast

Tubi Original The Fast Lane returns for its second live F1 altcast of the 2026 season, streaming free on Tubi for the United States Grand Prix in Austin. Hosted by YouTuber Michelle Khare ( Challenge Accepted ) and former racing champion and motorsports personality Justin Bell ( Drive to Wynn ), the creator-led altcast offers fans an alternative way to experience the action of the Grand Prix from Circuit of The Americas. Blending race insights, real-time driver tracking, and onboard footage with entertaining, culture-forward commentary, Tubi’s The Fast Lane delivers a fresh and accessible complement to the live race coverage on Apple TV.

F1 on Apple TV is available in the U.S. on the Apple TV app on iPhone; iPad; Apple TV 4K; Apple Vision Pro; Mac; popular smart TVs from Samsung, LG, Sony, VIZIO, TCL, and others; Roku and Amazon Fire TV devices; Chromecast with Google TV; PlayStation and Xbox gaming consoles; and at tv.apple.com , for $14.99 per month with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers. For a limited time, eligible customers who purchase and activate a new iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, or Mac can enjoy three months of Apple TV for free. Visit apple.com/tvpr and see the full list of supported devices .

articles.title: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo
articles.summary: Starting this Friday, iPhone Duo users can discover amazing apps and games optimized for the first foldable iPhone.
bodyEvidence: Text of this article
Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo
From streaming and gaming to creativity and productivity, developers worldwide are taking advantage of the unique capabilities of the first foldable iPhone

Starting this Friday, iPhone Duo users can discover amazing apps and games optimized for the first foldable iPhone. With an inner display that’s 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the flexibility to use iPhone Duo in a variety of poses, developers are enhancing their apps to create exciting new experiences for capturing and sharing memories, streaming entertainment, gaming, multitasking, and much more. Because both displays share the same aspect ratio, apps transition smoothly from the outer display to the inner display and scale proportionally, so users can pick up right where they left off. And with the breakthrough performance of A20 Pro and new capabilities for iPhone — including Split View — iPhone Duo helps users enjoy their favorite apps and experiences while staying productive wherever they are.

“The response to iPhone Duo from our developer community has been incredible, and we’re inspired by how quickly they’ve embraced its larger display and new ways to interact,” said Susan Prescott, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations. “From watching popular shows and content on the expansive inner display to multitasking across windows or playing console-quality games, developers around the world are reimagining what their apps can do. We can’t wait for users to discover these experiences beginning this Friday, with many more app experiences to follow.”

New editorial collections for iPhone Duo apps and games will go live on the App Store this Friday, with additional app updates rolling out throughout the year. Apps optimized for iPhone Duo are easy to identify with a Made for iPhone Duo badge on product pages across the storefront.
Enjoy Entertainment Anywhere

With the larger display on iPhone Duo, every show, movie, and match becomes a big-screen moment that still fits in a user’s pocket. Netflix makes finding great entertainment even more fun: Members can scroll through Clips on the outer display and then open iPhone Duo to keep watching on the large nano-texture inner display, with Clips switching seamlessly between a vertical or horizontal view.

“People watch Netflix in all kinds of moments, and we built our new experience to move with them,” said Tom Richards, Netflix’s senior director of Engineering. “From browsing Clips on the outer display to settling in with a favorite show on the inner display, the experience adapts as iPhone Duo opens, closes, or turns, so discovering something new and sitting down to watch it feels effortless.”

More streaming services — including Prime Video and Paramount+ — are joining Apple TV in using the larger canvas for movies and series. With iPhone Duo, Prime Video enhances the viewing experience for users as they stream premium entertainment, and when partially folded, content plays on the top half of the display while X-Ray details showing cast and bonus content appear on the bottom half. Paramount+ offers richer playback controls and expanded browsing for shows and live channels. When iPhone Duo is propped open on a table, users can easily enjoy content hands-free, without a stand. Sports fans can follow MLB and PGA Tour with live games and highlights, plus real-time scores, stats, and leaderboards on the larger display.

“Baseball fans are incredibly passionate about the sport, and they follow our games as closely as they can. Now, iPhone Duo provides an exciting new fan engagement platform by showcasing the action and information simultaneously,” said Kenny Gersh, MLB’s executive vice president of Media, Business Development, and Product. “This incredible device unlocks a fun, versatile way to experience baseball from anywhere, and we’re grateful to have worked with Apple to ensure the app is ready for the World Series. Set iPhone Duo on a table partially folded and the live game plays on the upright half of the display while real-time stats fill the half resting on the table, so fans never have to choose between the broadcast and the box score.”
Get More Done on the Go

With Split View, users can open two apps side by side on iPhone for the first time, and productivity apps are making the most of the extra room. In the coming weeks, Microsoft Word and Outlook will roll out a desktop-class experience in users’ pockets, placing Word’s formatting tools alongside a document and Outlook’s inbox next to a full message. Zoom turns the inner display into an immersive video conference room, so users can see shared content and other participants at the same time. Slack brings a user’s whole workspace into view, making it easy to follow channels and automate tasks. Salesforce helps teams manage customer relationships and act on business insights, with more of their dashboards in view.

Fantastical shows calendars, tasks, and menus together on the larger display, so users can take in more of their schedule at a glance. Note-taking and task apps are a natural fit for the larger canvas. Notewise brings notes, documents, and AI tools together in a single view, while Things and Bear make task management and organization simpler onscreen at once.

“Fantastical has always been about seeing your day at a glance, and iPhone Duo gives us more room to do that than any iPhone before it,” said Michael Simmons, cofounder and CEO of Flexibits, the maker of Fantastical and Cardhop. “With calendars, tasks, and menus visible together on the inner display, it feels like the full Fantastical experience from Mac and iPad, right in your pocket. And with Split View, you can easily look up contact details with Cardhop or plan your week right next to your inbox.”
Create and Share in New Ways

The folding design of iPhone Duo unlocks new ways to capture and edit, and creative apps are following suit. Detail uses the new Core AI framework to run AI models on device, making content creation fast and easy on the large inner display. Instagram shows more posts and Stories onscreen at once, and with Instagram’s Edits , creators can view their full creative studio, including timeline, editing tools, video, and more. VLLO gives video creators more editing controls and footage onscreen at once.

“iPhone Duo gives us room to put the video and its transcript side by side, which is exactly how creators want to edit podcasts and interviews,” said Paul Veugen, Detail’s founder and CEO. “Editing on the inner display feels as natural as editing a document, and because our AI models run on device, captions, filler-word removal, and audio enhancement are fast and private wherever creators are.”
Play on a Bigger Canvas

A20 Pro and a custom vapor chamber give iPhone Duo up to 35 percent better sustained performance than iPhone 17 Pro, so games look and feel great for longer gameplay sessions on the large inner display. In Asphalt Legends , players can race more than 350 cars against up to seven online opponents, with detailed cars and dynamic lighting filling the inner display. Zenless Zone Zero brings its fast-paced action to every way of holding iPhone Duo, with controls that adapt to each position, and UnGodly , a dark fantasy RPG from Azra Games, adjusts its controls and view for each display, including a taller view of its open worlds when iPhone Duo is closed. UnGodly launches on the App Store in November, and Zenless Zone Zero will be updated for iPhone Duo next month.

On Apple Arcade, Sneaky Sasquatch and Retrocade take full advantage of the folding display, delivering a uniquely immersive experience when opened, and convenient pick-up-and-play fun when closed — bringing to life the full versatility of iPhone Duo’s gameplay.

Independent developers are also finding playful ways to make the fold part of the fun. Deck-Man turns iPhone Duo into a retro cassette player: Users can open it to pick an album and insert the tape, and then close it to start listening with music from Apple Music .

“Asphalt Legends is all about speed and spectacle, and iPhone Duo lets players feel more of both,” said Raúl Orrego del Río, Gameloft’s game manager. “The large inner display and the sustained performance of A20 Pro let us put more of the track and every detail of our cars in front of users, so races look and feel incredible wherever they play.”
Cook, Shop, and More

When iPhone Duo is partially folded and placed on a counter, NYT Cooking shows more detailed recipes with richer visuals, making it easy to follow along while cooking. LTK lets shoppers watch creators’ videos and browse the exact products featured in the same view, while Lowe’s lets home improvement shoppers take a closer look at finishes, materials, and design details. Shop shows more products in its feed, with more room to discover, buy, and track orders, in every pose. When it’s time to make dinner plans, OpenTable adapts its layout, keeping restaurant details, availability, and booking easy to navigate. DoorDash will make it easy to track a delivery on a larger map later this year. And Yelp puts maps and reviews side by side so users can discover and compare local businesses with ease without tapping back and forth.

“We’ve spent the past four years bringing more instructional and inspirational video into NYT Cooking, and iPhone Duo helps bring that work to life,” said Camilla Velasquez, New York Times Cooking’s general manager. “With iPhone Duo propped on the counter, users can follow each step, set timers, and watch their favorite recipe creators demonstrate techniques, all with more room to see what they need. It’s another way we’re making our recipes more accessible, so people at every skill level can feel more confident in the kitchen.”

Updated travel apps from leading brands help keep trip details close at hand. Lyft gives riders more room to compare ride options and see the route at the same time alongside a larger route map, and American Airlines places boarding passes, seat selection, and terminal maps within easy reach. United Airlines brings its navigation to the right side of the display, giving travelers quick access to booking flights, managing trips, and other helpful tools throughout their journey. Flighty offers a dedicated flight-tracking mode for when iPhone Duo is propped up, making it easy to keep an eye on a flight.

Stargazers can explore the night sky across the inner display of iPhone Duo with Sky Guide , which pairs edge-to-edge star maps with Liquid Glass controls, while Tide Guide brings tide charts and live weather radar into one view. DJs can mix on the go with edjing Mix , which gives them more room for two decks, audio effects, and one-tap stem separation, while Next Shot helps golfers find and preview courses with immersive imagery, plus detailed views of stats and scorecards.
Favorite Local Apps from Around the World

In addition to many of these globally popular apps, developers around the world are bringing their most popular local apps to iPhone Duo, with experiences designed to take advantage of its larger display and versatile design.

In China, iQIYI offers more room to discover shows and films, and adjusts its playback controls to each position. WPS Office adapts its interface and controls to each position, making it easier to work on iPhone Duo, and Xmind brings mind maps and outlines together in a side-by-side view, letting users explore the big picture while working through the details. Weibo optimizes its feeds, videos, and posting tools for iPhone Duo, with layouts for reading, watching, and sharing when unfolded or partially folded. AMap adapts to the different poses of iPhone Duo, with a portrait view for the road ahead and a landscape view for the bigger picture. rednote provides more room to discover photos and posts, with layouts that adapt smoothly and a video view that brings playback and comments together on the larger display. Taobao takes advantage of the larger display to show more products, with zoom gestures to adjust the number of items per row and a side-by-side view of product images and details on the larger display.

In Korea, readers will be able to enjoy comics on WEBTOON and books on NAVER SERIES on a larger display. KakaoTalk lets users keep track of multiple chats and groups while diving into a specific conversation, without switching back and forth, while KakaoPage delivers an immersive, book-like reading experience with Split View. BAND gives communities more room to keep up with posts, events, and photo albums in a single space.

Across Europe, developers are bringing their apps to iPhone Duo. Airmail shows more of a user’s inbox and messages at once, without toggling back and forth. Craft offers more room across notes, tasks, and documents, with a style gallery and live preview appearing side by side when iPhone Duo unfolds. Tiimo features a compact view when iPhone Duo is closed for quickly checking plans for the day and ticking off tasks on the go. When propped up, it pairs a visual timer with notes and subtasks for hands-free routines and focus.

In Latin America, Tripsy tailors its app navigation for a seamless iPhone Duo experience, letting users plan trips in new ways, while SmartGym makes it easier to keep up with the next workout, displaying routines and exercise details side by side onscreen. Moises makes practice more immersive, letting musicians adjust vocals and instruments while following along with lyrics and chords.
Building for iPhone Duo

iPhone Duo opens up a new canvas for app experiences, and developers are already jumping in. More than 2,000 developers have attended more than 50 in-person workshops in 19 cities around the world — and additional workshops in London, Mexico City, Montreal, Paris, and Toronto will give even more teams the opportunity to experience iPhone Duo firsthand to update their apps and games. Through a range of online and in-person programming, technical guides, and Apple Developer Forums, developers have access to Apple engineers and designers to ask questions, get answers, and follow the discussion about all things iPhone Duo.

Developers can easily adapt their apps for iPhone Duo using new and updated APIs in the iOS 27.1 SDK. Apps that use standard SwiftUI and UIKit components adapt automatically to each display, moving controls to the side within easy reach, expanding into multiple columns on the inner display, and nudging buttons away from the fold when iPhone Duo is partially folded. New arrangement and reserved region APIs help developers build custom layouts that split content across the fold or extend edge to edge, and the new hinge API lets apps respond to the angle of the display as iPhone Duo opens and closes. With scene accessories, apps can show content on both displays at once, like a teleprompter on the outer display for the person being recorded, and new camera APIs support selfies with the rear cameras and the first under-display camera on iPhone.

Device Hub in Xcode 27.1 lets developers open, close, fold, and rotate a simulated iPhone Duo to test their apps in every pose. Design guidance and a series of Tech Talks for iPhone Duo are available on Apple Developer , and developers can submit their optimized apps to the App Store now.
