articles.title: Apple Photos keeps getting better, here’s what’s new in iOS 27
articles.summary: iOS 27’s biggest highlight is Siri AI, but the update also packs new features for apps like Messages , Notes , Wallet , and more . Here’s everything new for Apple’s Photos app in iOS 27. more…
bodyEvidence: iOS 27’s biggest highlight is Siri AI, but the update also packs new features for apps like Messages , Notes , Wallet , and more . Here’s everything new for Apple’s Photos app in iOS 27.
Apple Intelligence powers a trio of editing tools in iOS 27’s Photos app: Extend, Reframe, and a much-improved Clean Up feature.

Extend lets users “give their subjects more breathing room,” per Apple . For example, “they can straighten a crooked horizon without cropping out anything important, or adjust the aspect ratio, and Extend will fill in the missing pieces.”
Reframe lets you adjust the framing of your image spatially. Here’s how Apple describes it:

With Spatial Reframing, users can improve the composition of a photo after it’s been taken. Spatial Reframing builds on Apple’s deep understanding of spatial models thanks to Apple Vision Pro, so users can touch and drag a photo and preview in real time how the perspective shifts — as if they’d repositioned the camera in the original scene. Using powerful image models, Spatial Reframing will only generate new content where the perspective has been shifted, ensuring the reframed photo stays consistent with the original scene.
And the Clean Up feature that debuted in iOS 18 “gets a major upgrade,” Apple says, “so users can remove distractions with better quality and more realistic infill, even when the scene is complex.”
iCloud Shared Albums get their first major upgrades in years with iOS 27. The timing is likely no coincidence, with the feature perfect for Apple’s new HomeView product.
Here’s an overview of what’s new, per Apple :
iOS 27 adds two new collections to the Photos app, available under Utilities.
Captured by Me exclusively contains photos taken by you. So it will filter out screenshots, photos you’ve saved from others, and so on.
Identity Documents scans through your Photos library and surfaces images that contain important reference documents, like your driver’s license or passport.
Apple says iOS 27 also adds “Album organization improvements,” but it doesn’t mention specifics.

Another new organization tool in iOS 27 is that you can add keywords to photos. Captions are still available too, but if you scroll up on a photo, near the bottom you’ll find a new ‘Add Keywords’ option.
Another upgrade perfect for HomeView involves slideshow improvements.
Apple Photos has supported quick, easy slideshow creation for years. But if you wanted to customize the automatically generated slideshows, you were out of luck.
Now in iOS 27, slideshows offer new tools for customization. You can change the transition type, set a custom length for the full slideshow and for each photo, and more.
Another welcome addition is that Apple now lets you save any slideshow as a video with one tap.

iOS 27 doesn’t contain any big changes to the design of the Photos app, so if you were hoping to go back to the pre-iOS 18 era, you’ll be disappointed. But the update does offer a variety of exciting new features that make iOS 27 a big release for Apple Photos.

articles.title: Report: Apple reduces employees’ AI token allowances as Ternus moves to cut costs
articles.summary: Bloomberg reports that Apple has begun reducing employees’ daily AI spending limits, with some engineers seeing their allowances cut from $300 to $200, and further reductions planned across multiple teams. Here are the details. more…
bodyEvidence: Bloomberg reports that Apple has begun reducing employees’ daily AI spending limits, with some engineers seeing their allowances cut from $300 to $200, and further reductions planned across multiple teams. Here are the details.

Over the past year, tokenmaxxing, the practice of consuming as many AI tokens as possible, often as a measure of productivity, took over Silicon Valley, with companies such as Meta even introducing internal leaderboards, some unofficial, ranking employees by their AI token usage.
Tokenmaxxing emerged alongside improvements in AI agents’ coding capabilities, as tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Cursor became increasingly popular among software developers.

Unsurprisingly, companies soon began to rein in token usage as the rising costs of AI tools raised questions about whether the productivity gains justified the expense. Just recently, Accenture reportedly reduced its centrally funded Claude allowance to just $29 per employee per month, requiring any additional spending to be covered by individual projects or teams.

And while there hadn’t been reports of disproportionate token usage from engineers and other employees at Apple, Bloomberg reported today that the company is also looking to rein in employees’ AI spending as part of CEO John Ternus’ broader cost-cutting efforts.

Last month, Apple quietly lowered the daily spending cap for some engineers using AI models to $200 from $300, according to people with knowledge of the change. The company is now planning further cuts for some engineering teams, potentially reducing their daily allowances to as little as $100, said the people, who asked not to be identified because the discussions are private.

Many groups outside of engineering already face a $100 daily cap, but Apple has considered reducing that limit to as little as $25 for some teams, the people said. Employees who require higher allowances to perform their jobs will be able to seek exemptions from senior leadership.

It is not immediately clear which tools are affected by the new spending limits. However, Bloomberg reports that Apple employees have access to several AI services, including Anthropic’s Claude, OpenAI’s ChatGPT, and Google’s Gemini. Some teams are also being encouraged to use cheaper AI models or models that run locally on their devices to reduce costs.

Bloomberg ’s Mark Gurman had previously said that Apple was heavily reliant on Anthropic’s AI models for its internal operations, describing the company as essentially “running on Anthropic,” despite its partnership with Google to power Siri.

That came a few months after then-CEO Tim Cook encouraged employees to make greater use of AI in their daily work during an all-hands meeting, saying, “ All of us are using AI in a significant way already, and we must use it as a company as well.”

$200-$300 per day is a pretty high amount. There are certainly people and tasks that can effectively put that many tokens to efficient use, but my guess is that most people bumping those limits could be more efficient in their use.

You’re going to always have that one person who complains about the budget but is out there making small code changes running Fable on max. These blanket token budgets typically seek to limit damage from those types while those that can make a case for why they need more budget typically get it.

Back to today’s report, Bloomberg says employee reactions to the new spending limits have been mixed. According to its sources, “few workers were using their full $300 daily allowances,” while others “see the reductions as a sign of broader cost cutting, adding to concerns about potential layoffs.”

Interestingly, the cuts come as Apple’s overall spending continues to rise. Earlier this week, Apple reported its fiscal Q4 2026 earnings, bringing its fiscal year to a close with R&D expenses up 32% to $45.8 billion , driven in part by higher infrastructure and AI costs.
Bloomberg notes that it remains unclear how much Apple will actually save through the new restrictions, particularly since some employees weren’t using their full allowances to begin with.

bodyEvidence: A cozy habit tracker, a smarter snippet library, and a rooster that wants you out of bed: this year’s Shipaton winners offer plenty of new apps to explore.

RevenueCat’s annual app-building competition drew 3,985 project submissions in 2026, according to its winner announcement. Across the 20 first-place categories, developers tackled everyday frustrations, built inventive games, and found new ways to connect people.
You can get a look at every first place winner below, and read RevenueCat’s full winner announcement for every more.
1st place • Grand Prize Winner

Keeping a routine is easier when there’s something to look forward to. Mio pairs self-care and habit tracking with a pixel companion that grows as you make progress. Check off habits, earn coins, and unlock new companions and collectibles, with friends and groups adding a social reason to keep going.
Mio took Shipaton’s Grand Prize, with RevenueCat highlighting its revenue and growth in a crowded habit-tracking market.
App Store | Google Play
1st place • #BuildInPublic

That dog you met on your morning walk can become part of your collection. Boop identifies cats and dogs and turns their photos into stickers for a digital book, giving pet lovers a playful reason to pay attention to the animals around them.

Creator Taiwo Omisore’s “100 Boops” challenge took the app into the real world, where printed pet portraits and conversations with owners helped shape the product. That hands-on approach earned Boop first place in #BuildInPublic.
App Store | Devpost submission
1st place • Best Game Award

If you have fond memories of futuristic arcade racers, Nitelore has a familiar appeal: hovering vehicles, neon tracks, and plenty of speed. Chase your own ghost in time trials, take on combat races, or compete online.
Free tracks offer a starting point, while paid unlocks and daily and weekly challenges give players more to explore. RevenueCat’s Best Game judges singled out the art direction, effects, and haptics.
App Store | Google Play
1st place • RevenueCat Peace Prize

Explaining how you see color can be surprisingly difficult. See as Me: Colorblind makes that conversation visual, using a split-screen camera to compare different types and degrees of color blindness. A shareable link lets someone else see the comparison without installing the app.
Developer Javier Jiménez drew on his own experience with protanopia. That personal perspective helped the app earn the RevenueCat Peace Prize.
1st place • RevenueCat Design Award
Clucky’s rooster is determined to get you out of bed. Turning off an alarm can require solving a problem, moving around, or finding an object, bringing a little friction to the temptation to snooze.

Its personality runs through the entire interface, including a time picker that uses the rooster’s scrolling eyes and yellow beak. That consistent character, animation, and attention to detail earned Clucky the RevenueCat Design Award.
1st place • Catvertising Award

Adversary starts with a familiar challenge: flip cards and find matching pairs. The catch is a hidden Danger card with no matching partner. Reveal it, and an ad becomes part of the board you’re trying to remember.

That idea earned Niv Ben-porath’s game the Catvertising Award. Players can continue with ads after an initial ad-free period, or choose a permanent unlock that removes ads and adds difficulty options.
1st place • Next Gen Award
Put a few phones on the table, and Bubble Games turns their screens into a shared game board. Objects move between devices as friends compete in minigames, including a virtual hot potato.

Built by four software engineering students at Université Laval, the Next Gen Award winner uses the phones people already have to create a shared activity. Its Shipaton submission includes ten minigames. The winner announcement links to the Android release on Google Play.
1st place • HAMM Award (Help Apps Make Money)

GRIDLOCK takes a game everyone knows and adds up to four players, online rooms, and eleven special moves. The result offers more ways to disrupt an opponent’s plans than the familiar three-by-three board.

Its HAMM Award win recognizes how the business model fits the game: a shared Credits currency connects rewarded ads, optional packs, and a subscription, while core modes remain free. Players can choose the option that fits how often they play.
1st place • Influencer Award – Nutrition & Healthy Eating: Abbey’s Kitchen

Just Add begins with a craving. Type what you feel like eating, describe it aloud, or take a photo, and the app suggests three meals built around it, adding protein, fiber, and healthy fats to round out the plate.

Shopping support, hands-free cooking, and remembered preferences help carry the idea through to dinner. The winner of Abbey’s Kitchen’s nutrition challenge also impressed judges with a dinner-host feature that accounts for other people’s preferences.
1st place • Influencer Award – Productivity: Christopher Lawley

The reply you send every week, the PDF you keep hunting for, and the image you paste repeatedly can all live in SnipStash. It organizes reusable text, images, and files across iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with a keyboard, Mac quick palette, hotkeys, and Shortcuts bringing them within reach.
Private iCloud sync connects the library across devices. Its speed and native interface helped it win Christopher Lawley’s productivity challenge.
1st place • Influencer Award – Career Coaching: Leadership Heather
Knowing what you want to say and saying it aloud are different things. Rehearse – Hard Conversations gives you an AI counterpart to practice with before a difficult workplace discussion.

Choose from 33 prepared scenarios or bring your own situation, then review feedback on clarity, empathy, assertiveness, and structure. A prep card helps you take the useful points into the real conversation. The app won Leadership Heather’s career-coaching challenge for its focused, straightforward approach.
App Store | Google Play
1st place • Influencer Award – Gaming: Mr Lewis Blogs Gaming
You see a game in a short video, mean to look it up later, and forget its name. Game Magnet lets you share the clip to identify the games and save them to your backlog.

Processing happens in the background, with a notification when the result is ready. Shelves, ratings, and ranked lists help organize what comes next. The app won Mr Lewis Blogs Gaming’s challenge by making discovery and keeping track of games easier.
1st place • Influencer Award – Yoga & Fitness: Simone Sharice
FeelGood: Movement Menu starts with a short check-in about your energy, available time, and how you want to feel. It then offers a small menu of movement, with an appetizer, main, and optional sides.

The options span yoga, Pilates, strength, walking, stretching, and breathing. Rest is part of the experience, too. Yusra Salam and Ameena Malik’s app won Simone Sharice’s yoga and fitness challenge, with judges praising its calm, inviting design.
1st place • Ship Kotlin Everywhere
BoatBrawl brings arcade boat battles to a group of up to eight players. Steer, fire, and scramble through interactive arenas, with bots and shared-screen play offering more ways to join in.

Rehaan Cubes and Ashwin K M used Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform to bring the game across phones and computers, including iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, and the web. Its smooth browser play helped it take JetBrains’ Ship Kotlin Everywhere award.
App Store | Google Play
1st place • Most Viral App
Trazo: Golf Ball Tracer adds a ball-flight line to your own golf videos. Select the ball twice to start, and the processing runs on the phone.

Julian Praest’s app won Most Viral App for the way its team introduced the product through organic content. Golf humor and practical advice set up the tracer reveal, making the finished video part of the pitch. For golfers, the appeal is simple: make the shot easier to follow when you share it.
1st place • Best App for Galaxy
One Piece Card Game collectors know that similar-looking cards can be very different finds. Grandfolio helps identify artwork variants, manage duplicates, and track collection prices and progress.

The Best App for Galaxy winner impressed judges with layouts that adapt to folded, tabletop, and open-screen use. There’s an App Store release for Apple users, too, making this a relevant discovery even if your collection starts on an iPhone.
App Store | Google Play
1st place • Replit’s Idea to Income

Let’s Get Support by 3Dadz is designed for partners, parents, and friends affected by someone else’s addiction. Check-ins, journaling, boundary-setting tools, and local resources give those supporters a place to focus on their own needs.

Joshua Burgess and Aaryn B. built the app from community conversations in British Columbia, using Replit to turn the idea into a live product. It won Replit’s Idea to Income award. The announcement links to its Android release.
1st place • The Growth Loop Award

PoquitoTalk: Bocas del Toro turns English into local Spanish voice notes for WhatsApp and helps translate the replies. The recipient doesn’t need to install the app, keeping the conversation in a tool people already use.

Creator Dorien Van den Abbeele drew on years of life in Bocas del Toro. Its Growth Loop Award recognizes extensive growth experiments and an honest account of what the measurements could show. The announcement links to Google Play.
1st place • Keep Them Coming Back Award

Parky! combines wait times, dining availability, and memories from Disney and Universal visits. Built by former Disney Cast Member Chase Van Derrick, it aims to offer useful help throughout a park day.

Dining alerts can become conversations on the Lock Screen, where you can ask about another time or restaurant. Alongside queue Live Activities and recap messages, those interactive notifications helped Parky! win the Keep Them Coming Back Award.
1st place • Funnel Vision Award

In Your Own Words offers short, real-world speaking scenarios and feedback on pace, hesitation, and filler words. Speech analysis takes place on the phone, giving users a way to practice the words before they need them.

Natasha Wilson’s app won the Funnel Vision Award for connecting a web quiz, a relevant practice deck, and a web purchase that unlocks access in the app. The introduction to the product begins before the download.
Winner • Conflict of Interest Award

Friendpire turns the idea of a board-game night with friends into a shared hex-tile world. Gather resources, build farms and docks, and grow an empire together. RevenueCat employee Erik MacInnis built the game to make it easier to stay connected with friends who rarely find time to play.

Friendpire won the separate Conflict of Interest Award, which was open to RevenueCat and sponsor employees and judged by Shipaton participants. It is included here as an optional sidebar and is not part of the 20 first-place count above.

From a useful tool for the workday to a game for your next night in, Shipaton’s winners show how much can come from taking an idea all the way to a shipped app. Explore the winners above, or browse RevenueCat’s full announcement for more apps from the competition.

Last week, news broke that hackers had stolen $6.3 billion from wallets on Binance, the most popular cryptocurrency exchange in the world. The company was able to freeze about nearly $3 billion of it, but the attack quickly made headlines, and rightfully so, as the largest financial heist in human history.

At the time, I suspected, along with security researcher Christopher Lopez and plenty of others, that this could have very well started on a Mac. As Lopez pointed out , the $1.5 billion Bybit heist last year also began on a developer’s Mac. On top of that, Macs are hugely popular among DevOps engineers and crypto folks, and they’ve been on the receiving end of a steady stream of malware and social engineering campaigns over the past few years.

I can now say any suspicions that this heist originated on Mac were right. I’m still in a state of shock. Dazed not by the amount stolen, but how the said hackers did so using the same ol’ social engineering tricks they’ve been using for years. No sophisticated multi-milllion dollar underground zero-day here.

Yesterday, Binance published a more detailed breakdown of the attack. The company never actually says “Mac,” but the malware it published targeted /opt/homebrew, which is where Homebrew lives on Apple silicon Macs. In other words, this was almost certainly an M-series MacBook.
The attack basically transpired in two steps.

According to Binance , in June this year, a DevOps engineer working on Wallet searched for an AI coding tool and downloaded a malicious clone of the Homebrew installer in Google Search. Binance claims it caught it early and stopped any damage. However, what it didn’t know was that it allowed the attackers to learn which employees worked on its wallets. This was phase 1.

Fast forward a few months to September, a different engineer who, you guessed it, worked on wallets for Binance, was lured into a fake job interview. As these sort of social engineering attacks normally go, they told to run a coding “assignment” on their work computer. This was not caught by Binance security, and on October 29, the world learned that hackers (now widely speculated as North Korean hackers) walked off with billions.
Of course, most of what we know so far comes directly from Binance, so if you’re looking for more details on exactly how this happened, you’ll likely be left empty-handed.

It’s important to note here though, none of these two attack vectors are new. Back in early 2025, I wrote about fake Homebrew ads at the top of Google Search pushing Atomic Stealer to Mac users. Binance only says the engineer found his installer through “a search engine.” Of course, I can’t confirm it was a sponsored ad, but if history tells us anything…

This is a rather uncomfortable situation for Apple to be in. The largest financial heist in history happen on Mac last week, though to be fair, there’s no security feature that can stop a developer from running a script he wants to run.

Sure, the Terminal paste warnings introduced in macOS 26.4 could have helped here. But realistically, if someone’s convinced they’re doing a coding test for a job they really want, a warning pop-up probably isn’t going to stop them.

I’m having Christopher Lopez ( @L0Psec ) a professional macOS reverse engineer back on the Security Bite Podcast this week to talk about the Binance situation with me. Follow the show so you don’t miss that.

articles.title: With iOS 27.3, Apple will start checking iCloud public links for ‘harmful content’
articles.summary: iOS 27.3 adds lots of new iPhone features , and it also makes a change to how public iCloud links work with the aim of preventing harmful content from being shared. Here are the details. more…
bodyEvidence: iOS 27.3 adds lots of new iPhone features , and it also makes a change to how public iCloud links work with the aim of preventing harmful content from being shared. Here are the details.
This week Apple released the first iOS 27.3 beta, which adds Siri AI improvements , new Safari features , the all-new Apple Health app , and more.
Per a newly published support document on Apple’s website, iOS 27.3, macOS 27.3, and more also include a key change to how iCloud public links work.
Apple currently provides two main options when sharing photos, files, and more via iCloud. You can share with ‘People you choose’ or create a public link that works for ‘Anyone with the link.’
Starting with iOS 27.3 and companion updates, the ‘Anyone with the link’ option will start being checked by Apple for harmful content.
Per the support document :

When you share content that’s stored in iCloud, such as a photo in iCloud Photos or a file in iCloud Drive, you can choose to Share a Link or Send a Copy of the item. If you choose Share a Link, you can either share the item with “People you choose” — only people you invite or approve — or with “Anyone with the link,” which makes it accessible to anyone who has the link, including Apple. Starting in version 27.3 or later of iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, items shared using Anyone with the Link will be checked by Apple for harmful content.
If Apple flags the content you’re sharing as harmful, the support doc says it “reserves the right to move, refuse, modify, remove, or delete the content at any time.”

For anyone trying to upload harmful content, the company may “take action against your Apple Account, including blocking or disabling your Apple Account, blocking the ability to create a new Apple Account with the associated email address or phone number, or if necessary, involving law enforcement.”
As outlined above, choosing the ‘Anyone with the link’ option has always made it accessible to “anyone who has the link, including Apple.” That’s because it’s a public link.
What’s changing now, though, is that Apple says it will begin checking those public links for harmful content.
Do you use iCloud public links? What’s your take on this change? Let us know in the comments.

articles.title: Apple still charging 300% of costs on iPhone storage upgrades, says WSJ
articles.summary: Opting for more RAM or storage when buying Apple devices has always been an expensive business, with the company famously charging huge markups. Apple said in its most recent earnings report that even after the price increases, its margins are being squeezed by higher component costs. But an analysis suggests that the company is still charging three times its own costs for higher storage tiers on the iPhone 18 Pro … more…
bodyEvidence: Opting for more RAM or storage when buying Apple devices has always been an expensive business, with the company famously charging huge markups.

Apple said in its most recent earnings report that even after the price increases, its margins are being squeezed by higher component costs. But an analysis suggests that the company is still charging three times its own costs for higher storage tiers on the iPhone 18 Pro …

To be fair to Apple, some of the criticism about the premiums charged on configuring a device with more memory or flash storage hasn’t been comparing, well, apples with apples. The SSDs used in Macs, for example, are very much faster than the lower-spec third-party storage cards people typically cite as evidence for the company’s greed.
If it’s “still,” then there’s nothing untoward here. The market will decide what it wants to pay, and once it stops doing that Apple will change its behavior.
Is what I would say if BR, SS, & V didn’t exist. But they do. And they make these determinations, not actual people.

All the same, there’s no denying that the iPhone maker has always applied extremely high markups to its own direct costs. With the iPhone 17 Pro, for example, upgrading from 256GB to 1TB cost a buyer $400. A Wall Street Journal analysis cited by Macworld says that Apple’s cost at the time was $42, almost a 1,000% markup.
Apple this week warned that memory costs will reduce its holiday quarter profit margins .

When you remove the tariff refunds from both the June and September quarters, both company and product gross margin would be down about one point sequentially, primarily driven by higher memory costs. Parekh added that the pressure on Apple’s margins isn’t expected to ease anytime soon.

However, the WSJ’s number-crunching suggests that we probably don’t need to get out the violins just yet. The paper compared the same upgrade on the iPhone 18 Pro, where Apple has increased the price difference to $600. Although the Cupertino company is paying dramatically more, with an estimated direct cost of $192, that still amounts to customers being charged more than three times the price paid by Apple.

articles.title: How to get access to Sonos AI features, as company aims to avoid another app disaster
articles.summary: When Sonos tried a major app update two years ago, things did not go well. Much-loved features disappeared, older speakers experienced connection problems, and accessibility features were broken. That debacle saw the company’s CEO fired. The company is taking a much more cautious approach as it moves into the AI era with a Sonos 27voice update, enabling natural-language voice control via Hey Sonos requests … more…
bodyEvidence: When Sonos tried a major app update two years ago, things did not go well. Much-loved features disappeared, older speakers experienced connection problems, and accessibility features were broken. That debacle saw the company’s CEO fired.
The company is taking a much more cautious approach as it moves into the AI era with a Sonos 27voice update, enabling natural-language voice control via Hey Sonos requests …

The whole mess started when Sonos launched the company’s first headphones , the Ace, intended to compete with AirPods Max. The app needed to be updated to support these, and the company decided to use it as an opportunity for a ground-up rebuild, launching a completely new app just ahead of the launch.

Customers responded angrily to the loss of key functionality, compatibility issues with older speakers, and accessibility problems . Sonos initially downplayed the complaints , but CEO Patrick Spence subsequently emailed customers to apologize , and provide a timeline for fixes, subsequently making seven promises . However, customers weren’t impressed, and called for Spence to be fired – later getting their wish .

This time around, Sonos started out with a modest update in the form of the Sonos 27 app , leaving the more substantial changes to a subsequent Sonos 27voice version. This will replace the more limited voice control available today, much like the update from old Siri to Siri AI.

Rather than pushing it out to all customers, Sonos is adopting a very cautious approach. First, you’ll have to request early access to the beta and be approved. Second, the company is testing the feature with a relatively small group of users. Third, it’s seeking detailed feedback from beta testers before a planned launch next year.
The new features work in much the same way as Siri on HomePods.

You can use Sonos 27voice at any time by saying the wake word, “Hey Sonos.” While Sonos is listening, the white status light on your Sonos product will glow brighter and the volume will lower if any audio is playing. A confirmation tone will play after Sonos understands your request.

articles.title: 丰田成立机器人部门，整合研发资源加速技术落地
articles.summary: p data-vmark="f6d1" IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，丰田汽车公司（Toyota Motor Corp.）成立了专门的机器人部门，加入全球主要汽车制造商的行列，加速布局机器人技术。 /p p style="text-align: center;" data-vmark="8bd9" img src="https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/11/d01e58ed-b346-439a-92db-973861868026.jpg?x-bce-process=image/format,f_auto" w="554" h="554" data-weibo="0" data-vmark="3cbf" class="no-alt-img" /p p data-vmark="15a9" 丰田在一份声明中表示，该部门将由公司首席生产官志贺武文（Takefumi Shiga）负责，重点推动机器人在生产一线的实际应用、商业化及部署。此举旨在将公司此前分散开展的机器人研发工作整合到统一的组织架构之下。 /p p data-vmark="3376" IT之家注意到，越来越多的汽车制造商开始押注机器人领域，希望将自身在制造工艺和运动控制方面积累的技术优势，转化为在人形机器人和工业机器人研发中的竞争力。 /p p data-vmark="16c5" 拥有波士顿动力（Boston Dynamics）的现代汽车集团（Hyundai Motor Co.）已将机器人业务定位为核心增长支柱。与此同时，中国汽车制造商比亚迪（BYD Co.）也释放出投资机器人系统的信号，反映出汽车企业正将业务视野拓展至传统汽车市场之外。 /p
bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，丰田汽车公司（Toyota Motor Corp.）成立了专门的机器人部门，加入全球主要汽车制造商的行列，加速布局机器人技术。
丰田在一份声明中表示，该部门将由公司首席生产官志贺武文（Takefumi Shiga）负责，重点推动机器人在生产一线的实际应用、商业化及部署。此举旨在将公司此前分散开展的机器人研发工作整合到统一的组织架构之下。
IT之家注意到，越来越多的汽车制造商开始押注机器人领域，希望将自身在制造工艺和运动控制方面积累的技术优势，转化为在人形机器人和工业机器人研发中的竞争力。

bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，任天堂今日发布 2027 财年（2026 年 4 月 1 日～2027 年 3 月 31 日）半年报（2026 年 4 月 1 日～2026 年 9 月 30 日）业绩快报报告：
营业总收入 ：9660.41 亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 407.44 亿元人民币） ，同比下降 12.1%
毛利润 ：4864.59 亿日元 （现汇率约合 205.17 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 22.08%
毛利率 ：50.36%，同比增长 14.12 个百分点
归母净利润 ：2209.17 亿日元 （现汇率约合 93.17 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 11%
基本每股收益 ：191.63 日元 （现汇率约合 8.08 元人民币）
资产负债率 ：24.21%，环比增长 1.87 个百分点
整体业绩表现 任天堂本财年中期实现营收 9,660.41 亿日元（约合 407.44 亿元人民币），同比下降 12.1%，低于此前市场对单季度的营收预期；但归母净利润达 2,209.17 亿日元（约合 93.17 亿元人民币），同比增长 11%，盈利能力明显超出市场预期。利润超预期主要得益于软件销售强劲，以及美国《国际紧急经济权力法》（IEEPA）关税返还冲减了营业成本。
任天堂作为全球游戏主机与软件龙头，坐拥马力欧、塞尔达传说、宝可梦、喷射战士、火焰之纹章等顶级 IP。本财年上半年是下一代新主机 Nintendo Switch 2 发售后首个完整的累计半年运营期。
Nintendo Switch 2： 上半年硬件销量达 649 万台，软件销量达 2,449 万份。
上一代 Nintendo Switch： 硬件仍售出 127 万台，累计软件销量达 6,573 万份。
Switch 2 新作： 6 月发售的《星际火狐》售出 117 万份；7 月发售的《喷射战士：掠夺者》售出 242 万份；9 月发售的《火焰之纹章：万紫千红》售出 134 万份。
初代 Switch 平台作品： 《朋友聚会：精彩生活》售出 881 万份；《节奏天国：奇迹之星》售出 289 万份。
营业利润为 2,165 亿日元（约合 91.31 亿元人民币），同比大幅增长 49.1%。
经常利润为 3,006.76 亿日元（约合 126.81 亿元人民币），其中包含按权益法核算的投资收益 608 亿日元及利息收入 267 亿日元。
毛利率由去年同期的 36.24% 大幅跃升至 50.36%，成为驱动本期盈利超预期的核心因素。
数字业务销售额为 2,496 亿日元（约合 105.27 亿元人民币），同比增长 60.5%。
IP 相关业务收入为 627 亿日元（约合 26.44 亿元人民币），在电影《超级马力欧银河大电影》的带动下同比增长 87.9%。
海外销售额达 7,624 亿日元（约合 321.55 亿元人民币），海外市场占比为 78.9%。
公司总资产为 39,364 亿日元（较上财年末增加 1,301 亿日元），股东权益比率（自己资本比率）维持在 75.8% 的高位（上财年末为 77.6%）。负债总额为 9,529 亿日元（较上财年末增加 1,028 亿日元，主因是应付票据及应付账款增加）；净资产为 29,835 亿日元（较上财年末增加 283 亿日元）。
公司维持 2026 年 5 月 8 日公布的 2027 财年全年业绩预期不变：
全年营收： 预计为 2.05 万亿日元（约合 864.61 亿元人民币），同比下降 11.4%；
营业利润： 预计为 3,700 亿日元（约合 156.05 亿元人民币），同比增长 2.7%；
经常利润： 预计为 4,300 亿日元（约合 181.36 亿元人民币），同比下降 20.7%；
全年归母净利润： 预计为 3,100 亿日元（约合 130.75 亿元人民币），同比下降 26.9%；
每股收益（EPS）： 预计为 268.9 日元（约合 11.34 元人民币）。
股息分红： 本财年中期预计派息 76 日元（较上财年同期的 42 日元有所上调），期末预计派息 86 日元，全年股息合计 162 日元（上财年为 219 日元）。
下半年产品线规划： 公司计划推出《Nintendo Switch 运动度假胜地》、《塞尔达传说：时之笛》以及预计于 2027 年 1 月上市的《银河战士：狂暴》等新作；同时将推出“Nintendo Switch 2 塞尔达传说 40 周年纪念限定版”定制主机。
任天堂本财年中期整体呈现“增益减收”的格局：受两代 Switch 新老交替及硬件总销量缩减影响，营收同比有所回落；但受益于软件周期上行、高毛利的数字业务占比显著提高，外加关税返还冲减成本，推动营业利润同比大涨 49.1%，毛利率突破 50%。
展望下半年，Switch 2 的新作阵容与塞尔达 40 周年限定主机有望为硬件销量提供有力支撑；资本市场后续的关注重心在于全年 2.05 万亿日元营收目标的兑现情况（下半年需完成约 1.084 万亿日元）。总体而言，公司资产负债结构依然坚挺健康，具备持续进行股东回报的稳健能力。
《 任天堂 2027 财年第一财季归母净利润 1474.23 亿日元，同比增长 53.5% 》
《 任天堂 2026 财年年报净利润 4240.56 亿日元，同比增长 52.10% 》

bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，苹果官方昨日凌晨面向 iPhone 发布了 iOS 27.3 开发者预览版 Beta 升级。
除国行「Apple 智能与 Siri」外，IT之家实测发现，Safari 浏览器也迎来重要功能更新 —— 新增支持自适应深色模式 ：当某些网站本身并不支持深色外观时，Safari 可自动为每个网页应用深色外观。这意味着用户半夜浏览网页时，不用担心网页跳转时突然被“闪光弹”刺眼。
绝大部分网页都能适配这一全新特性，但也有例外，如苹果自己的 Newsroom 官网。
Safari 的自适应深色模式基于 Apple Intelligence 分析网页实现：开启后，浏览器会自动调整页面的浅色背景、文字对比度、图形配色及阴影，使其在深色外观下依旧清晰可读。 网站开发者可在页面代码中添加特定标签来阻止这一功能修改页面外观，从而保留原始配色。

除自适应深色模式外，本次 Safari 27.3 测试版还引入了垂直标签页功能：Mac 和 iPad 用户可通过“视图”菜单开启，iPhone 用户需前往 Safari 设置启用，并已针对苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 进行适配。 iOS 27.3 于 2026 年 11 月 4 日凌晨推送首个开发者预览版（Beta），预计 2026 年 12 月面向公众正式发布，届时 Safari 27.3 也将随 iPadOS 27.3、macOS 27.3 一同转正。

本次同步上线的国行「Apple 智能」是苹果 AI 体系自 2024 年 10 月在美国首度亮相后，首次面向中国用户开放测试。此前苹果于 2026 年 10 月 31 日宣布首批功能将随 iOS 27.3 开发者 Beta 版开放测试，并计划 2026 年 12 月正式推送。 国行 Apple 智能由苹果与阿里巴巴合作落地，将通义千问大模型集成进 Siri、写作工具与视觉智能等场景；相关服务已通过国家网信办生成式 AI 服务备案。 需要注意的是，国行 Apple 智能首批仅支持 iPhone 设备，机型包括 iPhone 16 及后续机型、iPhone Duo、iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max 和 iPhone Air，iPad 和 Mac 用户仍需等待。
此外，苹果自 2019 年发布的 iOS 13 起引入系统级深色模式，网页需通过 CSS 的 color-scheme 等属性适配；对于未适配的网页，此前用户多需借助第三方扩展或阅读器模式来实现深色阅读。

科技媒体 Macworld 认为苹果虽然面临成本上行，但并未真正“受伤”：其最新发布的 9 月季度创下公司史上最佳业绩，第四财季利润达 307 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,052.42 亿元人民币） ，全年利润达 1,322 亿美元 （现汇率约合 8,838.13 亿元人民币） ，均刷新纪录。

华尔街日报以 iPhone 18 Pro 从基础容量升级至更高存储版本估算，如果从 256GB 升级到 512GB，苹果公司实际支付物料成本约为 66 美元 （现汇率约合 441.2 元人民币） ，而消费者售价加价 200 美元 （现汇率约合 1,337 元人民币） ，溢价约 203.03%；如果从 256GB 升级到 1TB，物料升级成本约为 192 美元 （现汇率约合 1,284 元人民币） ，售价额外多 600 美元 （现汇率约合 4,011 元人民币） ，溢价约 212.5%。
《华尔街日报》发现，自苹果公司推出 iPhone 和 iPad 以来，到 2025 年，苹果每向 iPhone 和 iPad 用户收取 1 美元 （现汇率约合 6.7 元人民币） 的额外存储空间费用，平均毛利润超过 80 美分 （现汇率约合 5.3 元人民币） 。而自 2010 年以来销售的 Mac 电脑，平均毛利润也接近 80 美分 （现汇率约合 5.3 元人民币） 。
近几个月来，苹果公司提高了几乎所有产品的价格。iPhone 的价格平均上涨了 13%，其中也包括通常会降价的旧款机型。《华尔街日报》认为对苹果而言，问题在于消费者是否会因为价格上涨而延长 iPhone 的使用寿命，还是会继续保持以往的购买速度。而对于闪存制造商来说，问题在于苹果何时能够重新夺回其在闪存市场的主导地位。
与去年同期相比，苹果公司的利润率实际上略有上升（从 47.2% 升至 47.9%），而且从长远来看，利润率一直在大幅增长。十年前，苹果公司的利润率徘徊在 38% 左右。

articles.title: Counterpoint：三季度全球 DRAM 营收逼近 2000 亿美元，同比大增 369% 实现超级周期
articles.summary: p data-vmark="0000" IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，市场研究机构 Counterpoint Research 今日发布的《全球内存市场追踪》报告显示，2026 年第三季度全球 DRAM 市场营收接近 2,000 亿美元 span class="exch-money-value " （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.34 万亿元人民币） /span ，同比增长 369%，接近去年同期的 5 倍。 /p p data-vmark="a766" Counterpoint Research 指出，此轮 DRAM 市场增长主要由价格上涨推动，而非出货量大幅增加。当季 DRAM 单位出货量环比仅增长约 4%，每 Gb 平均售价则达到 1.9 美元。 /p p data-vmark="3e4c" 高级分析师 Jeongku Choi 表示，本轮行情属于价格推动的超级周期，而不是出货量周期。“AI 已经将内存从普通大宗商品转变为高价值稀缺资源，买家当前的核心动作是争抢供应而非议价，在价格持续上涨的背景下，存储厂商下一季度将再创新的盈利纪录。” /p p data-vmark="0003" 分厂商来看，三星电子以 38% 的市场份额稳居 DRAM 市场第一；SK 海力士环比营收增长超过 40%，大幅缩小与三星的差距，追回了今年早些时候丢失的部分市场份额；美光受 AI 数据中心内存需求拉动同样表现强劲，但增速落后于三星与 SK 海力士；长鑫存储的市场份额从二季度的 10% 下滑至三季度的 9%，随着竞争对手从四季度开始出货溢价更高的 HBM4 产品，长鑫存储的份额预计将持续承压。 /p p data-vmark="2432" style="text-align: center;" img src="https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/11/71ee6264-44f3-4779-8d66-9069b399450d.png?x-bce-process=image/format,f_auto" w="1440" h="886" data-weibo="0" alt="2026年第三季度DRAM营收市场份额" bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，市场研究机构 Counterpoint Research 今日发布的《全球内存市场追踪》报告显示，2026 年第三季度全球 DRAM 市场营收接近 2,000 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.34 万亿元人民币） ，同比增长 369%，接近去年同期的 5 倍。
Counterpoint Research 指出，此轮 DRAM 市场增长主要由价格上涨推动，而非出货量大幅增加。当季 DRAM 单位出货量环比仅增长约 4%，每 Gb 平均售价则达到 1.9 美元。
高级分析师 Jeongku Choi 表示，本轮行情属于价格推动的超级周期，而不是出货量周期。“AI 已经将内存从普通大宗商品转变为高价值稀缺资源，买家当前的核心动作是争抢供应而非议价，在价格持续上涨的背景下，存储厂商下一季度将再创新的盈利纪录。”
分厂商来看，三星电子以 38% 的市场份额稳居 DRAM 市场第一；SK 海力士环比营收增长超过 40%，大幅缩小与三星的差距，追回了今年早些时候丢失的部分市场份额；美光受 AI 数据中心内存需求拉动同样表现强劲，但增速落后于三星与 SK 海力士；长鑫存储的市场份额从二季度的 10% 下滑至三季度的 9%，随着竞争对手从四季度开始出货溢价更高的 HBM4 产品，长鑫存储的份额预计将持续承压。
从产品结构来看，HBM 营收几乎翻倍，但其在 DRAM 总营收中的占比反而下降，原因是传统 DRAM 产品增长更快。
Counterpoint Research 研究总监 MS Hwang 表示，随着新一代 HBM 产品陆续推出，厂商之间的竞争格局也在变化。SK 海力士此前在 HBM3E 市场占据优势，而三星 HBM4 获得客户积极反馈。他预计，三星有望在明年成为 HBM 市场份额最高的厂商。
传统 DRAM 的需求增长也与 AI 基础设施变化有关。Counterpoint Research 副总监 Brady Wang 表示，AI 智能体推动了传统 DRAM 需求增长。
Counterpoint Research 云端 AI 算力追踪数据显示，GPU 与 CPU 的配比已从 4:1 缩小至 2:1，并呈现进一步向 1:1 靠拢的趋势。以英伟达 Vera Rubin 机架为例，其每颗 CPU 插槽搭载的 DRAM 容量增至 1.5TB，接近上一代产品的 3 倍。
Brady Wang 还指出，DDR 和 LPDDR 的平均售价均升至历史高位，相关产品营收同比分别增长 500% 和接近 400%。随着服务器 CPU 用量增加，传统 DRAM 的需求预计还将继续增长，并可能进一步推高明年的每 Gb 平均售价，同时给边缘设备市场带来成本压力。
MS Hwang 同时补充道，“内存价格在明年将保持强势，今年涨幅落后于通用 DRAM 的 HBM 价格目前正在追赶，长期协议（LTA）对价格形成支撑，且由于主要新晶圆厂要到 2028 年才会投产，供应将持续偏紧，短期各家厂商的业绩会因 LTA 条款存在差异，但长期来看都会保持向上走势。”
对于后续走势，MS Hwang 表示，内存价格明年仍有望保持强势。此前涨幅相对滞后的 HBM 价格正在追赶传统 DRAM，长期供货协议也为价格提供支撑。此外，主要厂商的新晶圆厂预计要到 2028 年才会开始投产，供应紧张局面或将延续。
“海量需求推动 DDR、LPDDR 的平均售价创下历史新高，二者营收同比分别增长 500%、近 400%。我们观测到服务器 CPU 相关内存消耗正在显著提升，这将进一步推高明年每 Gb 的均价，同时给终端市场带来压力。”

bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，香橙派 (OrangePi) 今日公布了新品 OrangePi Zero 3W Pro。这是一款 "Zero" 级小尺寸单板计算机 (SBC)， 提供同级外形规格中少见的中端性能 。
OrangePi Zero 3W Pro 长宽仅有 65×30 (mm)，基于瑞芯微 RK3576 通用处理器，最高支持 16GB LPDDR 内存，可选 eMMC / UFS / microSD 存储，支持转接扩展 PCIe / SATA。
此外，这款 SBC 集成 Wi-Fi 6E & 蓝牙 5.3 无线模块，提供 Mini HDMI、MIPI-CSI、MIPI-DSI、支持 DisplayPort 1.4 Alt 的 USB-C 5Gbps、40-Pin GPIO，另有 2-Pin 5V PWM 风扇接口，无 RJ-45 有线网口。
香橙派表示，凭借集成的 NPU、VPU，OrangePi Zero 3W Pro 开发板 可以较小的体积在本地运行解码、轻量 AI 推理等工作负载 。

data-vmark="f76e" class="no-alt-img" /p p data-vmark="cbcc" style="text-align: center;" img src="https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/11/1ef929c8-3f62-4917-baf0-a1e7fac8acac.png" w="1440" data-vmark="38ea" class="no-alt-img" /p p data-vmark="8477" 针对不同访问者，系统也采取差异化响应：普通用户获得流式 HTML；经 IP 验证的搜索引擎爬虫获得完整、含结构化数据的文档；iMessage、Slack、Discord 等链接预览机器人则只获取标题、描述和卡片图片，避免渲染整页内容。 /p p data-vmark="16cd" bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）旗下社交媒体平台 X 于今天（11 月 5 日）推出重构后的网页应用，在 Slow 4G 慢速网络环境下， 账号主页的首条推文加载时间从 22 秒下降到 2.7 秒，时间缩短 87.73%。
IT之家注：Slow 4G 是指网络延迟约为 150ms，下行速度为 1.6 Mbps，上行速度为 750 Kbps。该模式是网页性能测试中常用的一种“较慢移动网络”模拟环境，用来衡量网站在信号弱、带宽有限、延迟偏高的真实手机网络下，需要多久才能显示内容。
X 首席工程师 Yagiz Nizipli 表示，旧版网页应用 rweb 已服务 X 网页版近十年，但其架构拆分用户渲染、搜索引擎渲染和链接预览到不同系统。同一个 URL 可能需要三种方式生成页面，导致 SEO 修复、错误页处理和元信息维护需要在多个代码库重复进行。
此外旧版对未登录用户采用“先下载外壳与 JavaScript、再请求数据、最后渲染”的流程。在网络较差时，每一步都会增加等待时间，用户往往只能长时间盯着启动画面。因此 X 工程团队已从零重建其网页应用，将原先分别服务普通用户、搜索引擎爬虫和链接预览机器人的三套服务器合并为一套。
新版应用采用 Vite、React、Fastify、Platformatic Watt、Relay 与 GraphQL 等技术，并引入流式服务器渲染。服务器会在数据到达时立即推送页面外壳和内容，浏览器无需等待全部 JavaScript 下载完成才能看到帖子。
针对不同访问者，系统也采取差异化响应：普通用户获得流式 HTML；经 IP 验证的搜索引擎爬虫获得完整、含结构化数据的文档；iMessage、Slack、Discord 等链接预览机器人则只获取标题、描述和卡片图片，避免渲染整页内容。
X 还用 Rust 重写链接预览卡片图服务，并优化图标、图片结构化数据、启动文件数量和样式表加载顺序。其中，登录前页面的启动文件从 582 个降至 10 个；部分页面的首次内容绘制时间明显下降。
X 表示，最初版本由不到 5 名工程师在不到 6 个月内完成，AI 编码智能体承担了大量移植、页面转换、测试编写和问题修复工作。工程师则主要负责架构设计、需求决策、代码审查和真实浏览器验证。
团队还通过统一的 AGENTS.md 指令、超过 25 个可复用工作流，以及提交前自动格式化、类型检查和 lint 规则，约束 AI 生成代码的质量。自 9 月底以来，已有超过 20 人参与该应用开发。
新版已服务未登录状态的 X.com 及搜索引擎抓取页面；登录用户正按国家和地区灰度迁移，旧版 rweb 仍作为回退方案保留。

articles.title: 内存涨价环境下 Discord 弃用 Electron：改用 Rust 重写客户端，占用体积从 4GB 降至 290MB
articles.summary: p data-vmark="c48d" IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，Discord 联合创始人兼首席技术官斯坦尼斯拉夫 · 维什涅夫斯基（Stanislav Vishnevskiy）今天在 X 上确认，Discord 已弃用 Electron 并正在用 Rust 重写桌面客户端，界面层采用 GPUI 框架。 /p p data-vmark="c7cd" 他同时表示，移动端也将逐步迁移至 Rust，iOS 和 Android 版当前使用的 React Native 将被替换，但移动端保留原生 UI，通过 Rust 与桌面端共享应用代码。 /p p data-vmark="9634" 他在 X 上分享的一张 Windows 11 任务管理器截图显示，一个名为“Discord Phoenix”的进程占用内存 290.2 MB。他随后说明，该截图中的客户端同时登录了两个账户（新客户端支持账户多开）。相比之下，旧版 Electron 客户端在空闲状态下通常占用 1 GB 至 2 GB 内存，极端情况下可达 4 GB。 /p p data-vmark="d5a7" style="text-align: center;" img src="https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/11/cf0628ae-f9e4-43f7-ba9b-d054236a2757.png" w="898" h="824" data-mpos="2,0" data-weibo="0" data-snap-from="%7B%22from%22%3A%22x%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fsvishnevskiy%2Fstatus%2F2118081920194203799%22%2C%22qualityMode%22%3A%22auto%22%2C%22qualityValue%22%3A%22original%22%7D" data-vmark="69bc" class="no-alt-img" /p p data-vmark="b073" 实际上，Discord 去年就已承认 Windows 客户端的资源占用问题。2025 年 12 月，一名 Discord 员工在 Reddit 上确认，公司正在测试一项机制：当内存占用超过 4 GB 时自动重启客户端。 /p p data-vmark="ecd7" 当时 Discord 表示，正常使用下内存应低于 1 GB，并已定位和修复多个内存泄漏场景，高负载下的 P95 内存占用下降了约 5%。 /p p data-vmark="face" IT之家注：P95 指将用户内存数据从低到高排序后位于 95% 位置的数值，即排除最极端 5% 情况后的高负载水平。 /p p data-vmark="f6e9" 公开资料显示，Electron 的资源开销源于其架构：每个 Electron 应用都打包一份完整的 Chromium 浏览器内核，而非像 WebView 那样与系统浏览器共享资源。Discord 被认为是优化较差的 Electron 应用之一，打开服务器或长时间使用后内存持续攀升。 /p p data-vmark="64be" 新客户端没有选择同样基于 Rust 的 Tauri 框架。Tauri 调用操作系统 WebView 渲染界面，虽能避免打包 Chromium，但仍依赖 Web 引擎。Discord 最终采用的 GPUI 由 Zed 编辑器团队开发，是一款 GPU 加速的 Rust 原生 UI 框架，不依赖 WebView 或 Chromium 进行界面绘制。 /p p data-vmark="aac3" 维什涅夫斯基表示，新应用仅在 YouTube 和 Activities 等嵌入内容场景调用系统 WebView，应用本身是原生的，外观和操作与现版保持一致。 /p p data-vmark="22f5" 维什涅夫斯基将“让整个客户端都跑在 Rust 上”称为一直以来的目标，并称新客户端“很快”将进入面向用户的测试阶段，但未给出正式发布时间。目前 Discord 官方尚未另行发布公告。 /p
bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，Discord 联合创始人兼首席技术官斯坦尼斯拉夫 · 维什涅夫斯基（Stanislav Vishnevskiy）今天在 X 上确认，Discord 已弃用 Electron 并正在用 Rust 重写桌面客户端，界面层采用 GPUI 框架。
他同时表示，移动端也将逐步迁移至 Rust，iOS 和 Android 版当前使用的 React Native 将被替换，但移动端保留原生 UI，通过 Rust 与桌面端共享应用代码。
他在 X 上分享的一张 Windows 11 任务管理器截图显示，一个名为“Discord Phoenix”的进程占用内存 290.2 MB。他随后说明，该截图中的客户端同时登录了两个账户（新客户端支持账户多开）。相比之下，旧版 Electron 客户端在空闲状态下通常占用 1 GB 至 2 GB 内存，极端情况下可达 4 GB。
实际上，Discord 去年就已承认 Windows 客户端的资源占用问题。2025 年 12 月，一名 Discord 员工在 Reddit 上确认，公司正在测试一项机制：当内存占用超过 4 GB 时自动重启客户端。
当时 Discord 表示，正常使用下内存应低于 1 GB，并已定位和修复多个内存泄漏场景，高负载下的 P95 内存占用下降了约 5%。
IT之家注：P95 指将用户内存数据从低到高排序后位于 95% 位置的数值，即排除最极端 5% 情况后的高负载水平。
公开资料显示，Electron 的资源开销源于其架构：每个 Electron 应用都打包一份完整的 Chromium 浏览器内核，而非像 WebView 那样与系统浏览器共享资源。Discord 被认为是优化较差的 Electron 应用之一，打开服务器或长时间使用后内存持续攀升。
新客户端没有选择同样基于 Rust 的 Tauri 框架。Tauri 调用操作系统 WebView 渲染界面，虽能避免打包 Chromium，但仍依赖 Web 引擎。Discord 最终采用的 GPUI 由 Zed 编辑器团队开发，是一款 GPU 加速的 Rust 原生 UI 框架，不依赖 WebView 或 Chromium 进行界面绘制。
维什涅夫斯基表示，新应用仅在 YouTube 和 Activities 等嵌入内容场景调用系统 WebView，应用本身是原生的，外观和操作与现版保持一致。
维什涅夫斯基将“让整个客户端都跑在 Rust 上”称为一直以来的目标，并称新客户端“很快”将进入面向用户的测试阶段，但未给出正式发布时间。目前 Discord 官方尚未另行发布公告。

bodyEvidence: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，米哈游今日宣布精灵养成冒险策略游戏《崩坏：因缘精灵》App Store 预约现已开启， 公测定档 2027 年春季 。《崩坏：因缘精灵》「幸福测试」及云游戏技术测试将于 11 月 25 日正式开始，测试招募时间为 2026 年 11 月 5 日 12:00 - 2026 年 11 月 22 日 09:59。
据官方介绍，玩家可通过填写招募问卷、参与官方活动等方式，抽取获得测试资格。「幸福测试」为 限量、删档、计费 测试，测试期间将开启付费功能，测试平台为 PC、 安卓 端、iOS 平台、云游戏。累计付费金额将在正式公测后，按照规则返还至测试期间进行过付费的同一米哈游通行证账号下。
IT之家从官方介绍获悉，《崩坏：因缘精灵》是一款米哈游「崩坏」IP 下的全新精灵养成冒险策略游戏。在本作中，您将扮演一位从幽禁中逃生的位面旅行者，在新世界与精灵建立心与心的连接，参与一场又一场因缘对决，并发掘隐藏在自己过去的真相。
